content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Conventional payment platforms often impose hefty fees and restrictions that hinder creators' ability to monetize their work. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can significantly eat into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing you to retain more revenue. This infrastructure empowers you by giving you full ownership and control over your sales process. By bypassing reliance on traditional payment processors, you can operate freely, ensuring that economic fluctuations or platform policies do not affect your income.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your ebook sales infrastructure, gather the necessary tools. You'll need a domain name, a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a database for order storage like Supabase or Google Sheets. Additionally, set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Lastly, sign up for NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions. Having all these components in place ensures a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processing system with NOWPayments. Integrate it into your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate payment verification. Next, set up your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring all transactions are tracked accurately. After that, link your file delivery system to your storage solution, allowing customers to receive their ebooks automatically after payment confirmation. This streamlined pipeline provides a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Retain more profits with low transaction fees from NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all links and payment buttons function correctly. Test the entire process by making a small purchase yourself to verify that payments are processed through NOWPayments and that the ebook delivery is automated. This initial transaction will help you identify any potential issues and confirm that your setup is fully operational. You are now ready to start selling your ebooks to customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing sales, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Increase your product offerings by adding more ebooks or digital products to your store. Utilize marketing strategies such as social media promotion and email marketing to reach a broader audience. Monitor your transaction volume and adjust your backend systems if necessary to handle increased traffic. With the Complete Builder Kit, you have access to comprehensive blueprints and templates that can further enhance your infrastructure, allowing you to grow without limitations.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce infrastructure like Coremerch. This allows you to accept Bitcoin directly, ensuring low fees and complete ownership. NOWPayments enables you to process transactions seamlessly, and with the right setup, you can automate delivery and retain more profits, creating a sustainable income stream.
Automate ebook delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my ebook sales?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their platform. Follow their integration guide to connect it with your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Make sure to configure your cryptocurrency options and set up payment buttons on your site.
What tools do I need for hosting my ebook store?

You need a domain name, a reliable hosting service such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a backend solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools will help you create a functional and efficient ebook store.
Can I automate ebook delivery?

Yes, by linking your order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, with your file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can automate the delivery process. This ensures that customers receive their ebooks immediately after payment confirmation.
What are the fees associated with selling ebooks using this infrastructure?

Using NOWPayments, you'll incur only a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This difference means you retain more earnings from each sale, enhancing your profitability.
How can I scale my ebook sales infrastructure?

To scale, consider adding more digital products to your store and implementing marketing strategies to increase traffic. Adjust your backend systems as needed to handle larger volumes and utilize the Complete Builder Kit for additional blueprints and templates.
